probe.title: Chambres d'Amis
probe.text_sample: Chambres d'Amis × Celebrate the Festive Season with Chambres d’Amis We love bringing the year to a close together. Join us at Chambres d’Amis for a festive New Year’s Eve dinner in the heart of Kortrijk. Celebrating at home instead? Our Christmas and New Year’s Eve festive boxes bring chef Matthieu Beudaert’s cooking to your table, so you can enjoy a taste of Chambres d’Amis at home. In the kitchen, Matthieu Beudaert draws on French and Italian culinary traditions, guided by the seasons.
